attempts.note: The adaptor's only vendor call is changesApi(): POST `${server}/${db}/_changes?${qs}` (plus `filter=_doc_ids` and a `{doc_ids}` JSON body when doc_ids is given), HTTP Basic auth, query from params with the state cursor sent as `last-event-id`; fetchSubmissions() wraps it and POSTs each submission to a caller-supplied postUrl (not a vendor endpoint); pickFormData() is local. No generic get/post/request builders. configuration-schema: server ('Medic's CouchDB api URL', e.g. https://standard.app.medicmobile.org), db (e.g. medic), username, password. So the API is CouchDB's database API on a Medic/CHT instance, not the CHT API.

Medic's CHT API spec (already committed verbatim as specs/adaptors/cht/upstream.json, 65 paths) describes only the CHT API server's /api/v1-v3, /api/info and /api/sms routes; it has no /{db}/_changes or any other CouchDB route (the cht spec's notes record the same gap). Reusing it would cover none of what medicmobile calls.

notes: Apache CouchDB 3.5 HTTP API, as reached through a Medic Mobile / Community Health Toolkit instance. The medicmobile adaptor (the pre-cht Medic adaptor) calls CouchDB directly — POST {server}/{db}/_changes on the instance's `medic` database — not the CHT API that specs/adaptors/cht describes (Medic's spec has no CouchDB routes), so the CHT vendor spec could not be reused; the previous file here was a 4-operation stub. Apache publishes no machine spec for CouchDB, so this is authored from the CouchDB documentation: 'full' means every one of the 135 entries in its HTTP routing table, with parameters, headers, status codes and descriptions scraped from each entry's structured field list, and response/request schemas (83, named after the documented JSON objects, with the documented example responses attached to 13 of them) written from the documented fields and examples. POST variants and design/local-document endpoints that the docs describe as 'the same as' a GET or document endpoint inherit that endpoint's query parameters. Known gaps: the three COPY endpoints cannot be expressed in OpenAPI 3.0 and are only named in info.description; `_rewrite` (any method) is modelled as GET/POST/PUT/DELETE; continuous/eventsource `_changes` streams and multipart (`_bulk_get`, attachments with `multipart/related`) bodies are described only as their JSON forms; show/list/update/rewrite responses are untyped because the design document decides them; and CouchDB documents are open objects — the CHT `data_record`/contact shapes the adaptor reads (`form`, `fields`, `reported_date`, `contact`) are not encoded. Adaptor surface verified against ast.json (fetchSubmissions, changesApi, pickFormData) and src/Adaptor.js: changesApi's POST /{db}/_changes with include_docs, last-event-id, filter=_doc_ids and the doc_ids body is modelled (postChanges); fetchSubmissions' POST to postUrl targets an OpenFn inbox, not CouchDB, and is not modelled.
